meta.description: One Nebula Studios account for every product we ship — sign up once, use it everywhere.

hero.description: One account, everything connected. Identity management that is secure, direct and seamless.

features.label: Features
features.description: From creating an account to managing permissions, every detail is deliberate. Beneath a plain surface sits a tight security system.

identitySecurity.name: Identity security
identitySecurity.desc: Encrypted at rest; passwords are never stored in plaintext. A password change takes effect immediately, and everything is logged.

profile.name: Profile
profile.desc: Your username, avatar and email address, all yours to change. The account belongs to you.

thirdParty.name: Third-party access
thirdParty.desc: See and manage every application you have authorised. Revoke access at any time.

activityLog.name: Activity log
activityLog.desc: A complete record of what happened on the account. An unexpected sign-in is visible the moment it happens.

oauth.name: OAuth
oauth.desc: Sign in and link accounts with Microsoft and Google, and issue tokens to your own clients.

dataExport.name: Data export
dataExport.desc: Export everything at any time. Your data is never held in place.

manifesto.text1: We believe **authentication should not be a burden**. It should be invisible and reliable, like air — there when you need it, never in your way.
manifesto.text2: The Nebula Studios account system is built from scratch and refuses bloated solutions. **Every line of code has a reason**, and every interaction is worked over until it settles.
manifesto.text3: Security is not a feature, it is **infrastructure**. Privacy is not an option, it is the **default**. That is the promise to every account.

cta.description: An email is all registration needs. No card, no hidden charge, the full account from the first minute.
cta.alreadyHaveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in

login.title: Sign in to Nebula
login.subtitle: Use your email and password, or a linked third-party account.
login.remember: Keep me signed in on this device

register.title: Create account
register.subtitle: Enter an email and password, then confirm with the code we send you.
register.usernameTooShort: Your username must be at least 3 characters

totp.title: Two-factor verification
totp.hint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator. It expires after 30 seconds.
